messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up 3 planning a canary for flag `route_by_signal` (per-user routing) at 3% tomorrow. Before we flip I want: (A) console preview that shows per-user routing decisions + sampled candidate responses, (B) telemetry for latency/cost/semantic-drift, (C) a safe auto-pause rule. Tagging @Priya @Leo.

Priya: Telemetry wishlist: p95 latency per-route, avg tokens-per-response, request_failure_rate, batch_hit_rate, and a lightweight semantic-drift (mean embedding dist to baseline). Also capture 0.05% sampled prompt/response pairs (with trace-id) for manual triage.

Leo: Safety guard proposal: run in shadow first. Pause if any of: p95(route) > baseline_p95 + 50ms (5m window), absolute error-rate increase > 0.3% over baseline (5m), or tokens-per-request > baseline * 1.10 for 5m. When paused, create ticket and mark rollout state "PAUSED_BY_AUTOPROBE". No auto-rollback.

Jordan: Console UX: add a "Shadow results" column in rollout preview to show what the alternative route would return. Also add an "Audit snapshot" modal that shows the config diff + previous snapshot id and checksum before any apply. We should show an estimated monthly cost delta at top.

Priya: Example alert pseudo (PromQL-like):
```
# error-rate increase for routeX over 5m
(delta(route_errors_total{route="routeX"}[5m]) / delta(route_requests_total{route="routeX"}[5m]) - baseline_error_rate) > 0.003
```
Cost alert (pseudo):
```
avg_over_time(tokens_per_request{route="routeX"}[10m]) > baseline_tokens * 1.10
```
When either fires -> `route_regression` alert.

Nina: Ops preference: auto-pause + pager on first fire, manual rollback. Runbook snippet: `if alert == route_regression then redwoodctl config pause --flag route_by_signal --who=ops --reason="auto-pause:regression"`

Leo: Also add CLI rollback stub: `redwoodctl config rollback --flag route_by_signal --to=snapshot-<id> --reason='regression'`. Ensure rollback emits an audit event with snapshot id, author, and diff hash. Console should show the diff and require a one-click confirm.

Priya: We need quota watch too 3 route variant disables batching; add a quota alert if per-minute spend > baseline_spend * 1.25 OR estimated monthly delta > $3000.

deploy-bot: Started rollout job r-1766601111 (shadow mode) for `route_by_signal` cohorts hash [0..3%).

Jordan: Action items: I'll prototype the shadow column + audit modal. Priya will draft alert rules + example dashboards. Leo will wire auto-pause state + audit events in the rollout service. Nina will author runbook pager + ticket template. We'll do a quick runbook review tomorrow 09:30. :thumbsup:
